tweet.text:
Andrej Karpathy just compressed 8 years at OpenAI and Tesla into one free 2-hour lecture.

The progression it covers: Agents, then Loops, then Graphs, then Self-Improving Systems.

Two hours is a lot to ask on a weeknight. It is still shorter than the intro module of most paid AI courses.

The people who watch it tonight will be six months ahead of everyone who screenshots it and forgets. Bookmark this
